wiki_text: The Alexandroupolis FSRU was shut down in late January 2025 following a booster-pump failure. It restarted operations in August 2025 at roughly 25% of nominal capacity, then returned to full nominal capacity (5.5 bcm/y) on 1 October 2025. The terminal continued receiving LNG cargoes into 2026 (e.g. a cargo delivery reported 6 July 2026), and utilization/commercial questions raised in 2025 about slot bookings had eased by the time of this review.

GEM records Argo FSRU's baseload/nameplate capacity as 5.20 bcm/y (the figure Mediterranean Gas has marketed and market-tested since 2022). Some 2025 reporting cites a higher maximum/peak throughput figure of up to 7.6 bcm/y for the same facility; this peak figure is not used as the nameplate Capacity value per GEM convention (baseload, not peak).

In July 2026, AKTOR Group announced it had agreed IN PRINCIPLE to acquire a 50% stake in Dioriga Gas (the Dioriga FSRU project company) from Motor Oil Hellas. The deal is preliminary -- subject to definitive contracts and regulatory approval -- and had not closed as of this review. Separately, the project has faced a grid-connection dispute with DESFA over inclusion in the transmission system's Ten-Year Development Plan; company sources describe the standoff as easing in 2026 but a finalized/approved plan confirming reinstatement was not found.

Gastrade's second Alexandroupolis-area FSRU, the Thrace FSRU (also called 'Alexandroupolis 2' or the 'Sea of Thrace' FSRU), received environmental-permit approval from Greece's Ministry of Environment and Energy (YPEN) on 27 January 2026. The project is sited roughly 8 km from the existing Alexandroupolis FSRU, sized for >6 bcm/y regasification and up to 185,000 m3 of LNG storage, at an estimated cost above EUR650 million (without the EIB preferential financing the first FSRU received). Gastrade (Copelouzos Group) is targeting a final investment decision within 2026, contingent on securing 15-year LNG supply contracts, with an operational target of 2028 -- the first year of the EU's full ban on Russian gas imports.
